original_ai_output.title_zh: NNPC就埃莱梅管道爆炸启动应急响应
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）确认，2026年10月15日其子公司NGIC位于河流州埃莱梅地方政府区阿莱托社区的天然气管道发生爆炸。公司称对有关人员受伤及房屋商铺受损的报告深表关切，已隔离受影响管段并联合监管机构与安全部门展开应急响应。事故原因及影响范围仍在评估中，官方表示将在获得核实信息后进一步通报。

location.raw_text: Aleto community, Eleme Local Government Area of Rivers State

key_facts.fact: NNPC确认其子公司NGIC的天然气管道于2026年10月15日发生爆炸
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an explosion occurred on Thursday, 15 October 2026, on a gas pipeline belonging to its subsidiary, NNPC Gas Infrastructure Company Limited (NGIC), in Aleto community, Eleme Local Government Area of Rivers State

key_facts.fact: 公司称对人员受伤及房屋商铺受损的报告深表关切
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We are deeply concerned by reports of injuries and damage to homes and businesses.

key_facts.fact: NGIC已启动应急程序并隔离受影响管段
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NGIC has activated its emergency response procedures and isolated the affected pipeline segment to limit further impact

key_facts.fact: 事故原因与影响范围仍在评估中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The cause of the incident and the full extent of its impact are currently being assessed.

uncertainties: 人员受伤情况仅为公司提及的“有关报告”，具体伤亡人数尚未证实
事故原因尚未确定，仍在评估中
影响范围（人员、财产、环境）尚未确认
目前仅NNPC单一来源发布，尚无独立来源交叉验证
